dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin measured at approximately 75 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis, with a slight proximal convexity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-dominant profile; vertical pixel height is approximately 1.4 times the longitudinal base width.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast pigment boundary between the dark dorsal cape and the bright white ventral/lateral field, with scattered spotting in the transition zone.
